<div class="not-prose [&amp;_a]:underline border-default border border-solid rounded-lg p-2 py-4 pl-5 mt-4 first:mt-0 mb-4 text-sm"><div class="flex items-center gap-4"><div class="text-default"><svg width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" class="w-4 h-4"><path d="M13 12a1 1 0 1 0-2 0v4a1 1 0 1 0 2 0v-4Zm-1-2.5A1.25 1.25 0 1 0 12 7a1.25 1.25 0 0 0 0 2.5Z"></path><path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M12 2C6.477 2 2 6.477 2 12s4.477 10 10 10 10-4.477 10-10S17.523 2 12 2ZM4 12a8 8 0 1 1 16 0 8 8 0 0 1-16 0Z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div><div class="text-default not-prose "><p>If you’re a developer and want to use Codex in your terminal or code editor,
try <a href="/codex/cli">Codex CLI</a> or the <a href="/codex/ide">Codex IDE extension</a>. For remote
coding work, create a reusable <a href="/codex/environments/cloud-environments">Codex Cloud
environment</a> on the web or in the
desktop app. In a new task, choose <strong>Work in</strong> &gt; <strong>Cloud</strong>, open <strong>Select
environment</strong>, then select <strong>Create environment</strong>. Codex inspects your
repositories and helps prepare and test the setup before you publish it.
You can then start and continue cloud tasks on the web, on mobile, or in the
desktop app. On mobile, open <strong>Codex</strong> and select the published environment.</p></div></div></div>

<li>
<h3 id="setup-app-sign-in">Open the ChatGPT desktop app and sign in</h3>
<p>Open the app, then sign in with your ChatGPT account.</p>
<p>You may also use Codex with an API key. <a href="/codex/pricing#feature-availability">Some features might not be available</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<h3 id="setup-app-select-workspace">Select where ChatGPT should work</h3>
<p>Start a chat, create a project, or open a folder. ChatGPT can read and modify
files in the folder you choose. <a href="/codex/projects">Learn more about chats and projects</a>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<h3 id="setup-app-start-task">Start a chat</h3>
<div class="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(17rem,20rem)] md:items-start"><div><ul>
<li>For research, analysis, or deliverables such as documents, presentations,
spreadsheets, and Sites, select <strong>ChatGPT</strong>, then switch to <strong>Work</strong> at the
top of the new chat page, above the composer.</li>
<li>For software development with codebase context and developer tools, select
<strong>Codex</strong> from the ChatGPT dropdown.</li>
<li>For a quick question or chat, select <strong>ChatGPT</strong>, then select <strong>Chat</strong>
in the switcher at the top of the new chat page, above the composer. In
Codex, point to <strong>New chat</strong>, then select the <strong>Quick chat</strong> icon on its right.</li>
</ul><p>Learn more about <a href="/codex/use-chatgpt">using ChatGPT</a>.</p></div><astro-island uid="ZnSBPp" prefix="r17" component-url="/_astro/ChatGPTModeDropdown.react.DaAuvo0w.js?dpl=dpl_7iHSYrJ5jPyHvJgcWEVxZrsjhkmE" component-export="default" renderer-url="/_astro/client.CrYBL8V7.js?dpl=dpl_7iHSYrJ5jPyHvJgcWEVxZrsjhkmE" props="{}" ssr client="visible" opts="{&quot;name&quot;:&quot;ChatGPTModeDropdown&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:true}" await-children><div class="_illustration_f6f0e_1 not-prose"><p id="_r17R_0_" class="_srOnly_f6f0e_9">Interactive illustration of the ChatGPT desktop app product selector and sidebar. <li>

</ol><p>Go to <a href="https://chatgpt.com">ChatGPT</a> and sign in with your ChatGPT account.</p><ol start="2">
<li>
<h3 id="setup-web-start-task">Start a chat</h3>
<div class="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(17rem,20rem)] md:items-stretch"><div><ul>
<li>Select <strong>Chat</strong> to ask questions, explore ideas, and work through a topic
conversationally.</li>
<li>Select <strong>Work</strong> to research, analyze information, and create documents,
presentations, spreadsheets, Sites, or other finished work.</li>
